title: St Martin (11/11): 'Iste confessor' holds Lauds hymn option 1, but the body's Lauds hymn is 'Martine par apostolis'; p934 labels Vespers 'Laudes'
prompt: p932 (Die 11: S. Martini Turonensis): 'Off. lect. H Iste confessor ut ad Vesperas' / 'Laudes H Martine par apostolis (LHym 466)', then Lauds antiphons 1-3 and B 'O beatum virum' (p933). p934 then prints a SECOND 'Laudes H Iste confessor (LHym 466)' followed by antiphons 1-3 (O virum ineffabilem, Domine si adhuc, …) and an M (Magnificat) antiphon 'O beatum pontificem' on p935, so that section is Vespers mislabeled 'Laudes' (Off. lect. says 'ut ad Vesperas'). The hymn index (p1219) codes #174 Iste confessor '11/11 L V' (following the label) and #193 Martine par apostolis '11/11 L'. Loaded now: martin-of-tours LAUDS.hymn option 1 = Iste confessor (gregobase:9111); Martine (gregobase:4026, row r5855) is held as a conflict.
